notes:
Use case detail, base flow, full scroll length (1440×1560). Data: `get_use_case` (variant-resolved bundle). Sample: "Map a step to a screen element" (persona Dana, designer).

**Sections, in order (as built).**
1. Header: group path (folder icon), title (`typography.ui-heading` 20px), actions Show on screens · Edit · More (`more_horiz`, "More actions" → menu with "Delete use case" → `usecases-delete-confirm`). Meta row: `uc-status` (Draft or Ready — ADR-010; no priority), tags, id as `chrome-chip ref` on the right (click copies, toast "Copied.").
2. Variant bar: `uc-variant-chip` per variant (`selected` = current, Base here), `+ Variant` (→ `usecases-edit-dialog-variant`). Right: coverage hint "8 trait values not covered" (warning colour) — toggles the full-width Coverage section (see `usecases-detail-variant`); with no gaps it reads "Coverage".
3. People: personas as `uc-avatar lg` + role and trait summary.
4. Trigger · Goal · Outcome as one bordered three-cell strip (not three cards).
5. Flow: vertical spine, one row per step: actor avatar (`system` for actor `system`), "Step n · Actor", action (`ui-md` 14px), `uc-target-chip`. All target states are drawn: Element (steps 1, 3), Element with a **generated id** (step 2: warning line "n184 is a generated id …"), **Stale** (step 4: screen gone, warning line "Screen usecases-editor no longer exists. Pick a new target."; a stale node reads "Element <id> no longer exists on <screen>. Pick a new target."), **Screen** (step 5, whole screen). No steps → "No steps yet.". Steps with `data` show **before → after** `uc-data-card`s on the right; changed fields highlighted accent-subtle.
6. Inputs and outputs: two columns of data-object cards (name, id mono, "from <source>" / "to <target>") with a Field · Type · Example table. Output rows whose example differs from the input are highlighted accent-subtle.

**States.** While the bundle loads (and nothing is shown yet) the column holds a centred placeholder "Loading…" (tertiary, min-height 240); a case that is gone shows "This use case no longer exists."; other errors show the server message in the same placeholder. Reloading after a write keeps the current view until the new one arrives.

**Interactions.** Target chip → `usecases-mapping` focused on that step. Variant chip / coverage hint → `usecases-detail-variant`. Edit → `usecases-edit-dialog`. Avatar colours are persona data (`--avatar-color` on a wrapper), not tokens.
